targets.rawSql:
SELECT pid, barcode, status, `condition`, availability, scan_location,
  tote, tote_simplified, tote_number, `partition`, scanned_at, nexs_location
FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory
ORDER BY scanned_at DESC

SELECT 
COUNT(distinct (pid))
from mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory
select COUNT(distinct barcode) FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory

SELECT 
  $__timeGroup(scanned_at, '5m') AS time,
  COUNT(barcode) AS scan_count
FROM scanned_barcode_inventory
WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT barcode, MAX(pid) AS pid, COUNT(*) AS history_records,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN current_location END) AS latest_location,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN tote_id END) AS latest_tote,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN CONCAT(tote_number, '-', `partition`) END) AS latest_tote_simplified,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN tote_number END) AS latest_tote_number,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN current_location END) AS previous_location,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN scanned_at END) AS latest_scan_at,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN scanned_at END) AS previous_scan_at
FROM (
  SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY barcode ORDER BY scanned_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
  FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans s
) ordered
GROUP BY barcode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY latest_scan_at DESC

SELECT pid, COUNT(DISTINCT barcode) AS barcode_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tote) AS tote_count
FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory
GROUP BY pid
ORDER BY barcode_count DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans WHERE mode = 'PLACEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT barcode) AS value FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans WHERE mode = 'PLACEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans WHERE mode = 'PLACEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND bucket = 'GOOD'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans WHERE mode = 'PLACEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND bucket <> 'GOOD'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(scanned_at, '15m'), bucket AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans
WHERE mode = 'PLACEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT scanned_at, barcode, pid, bucket, status, `condition`, availability, tote_number, `partition`, current_location, nexs_location
FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans
WHERE mode = 'PLACEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
ORDER BY scanned_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans WHERE mode = 'COMPACTION' AND compacted = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT barcode) AS value FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans WHERE mode = 'COMPACTION' AND compacted = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (
  SELECT scanned_at, compacted_from, current_location
  FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans
  WHERE mode = 'COMPACTION' AND compacted = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
  GROUP BY scanned_at, compacted_from, current_location
) moves

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT tote_number, bucket, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY barcode ORDER BY scanned_at DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
  FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans
), occupied AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tote_number FROM latest WHERE row_num = 1 AND bucket = 'GOOD' AND tote_number IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT tote_number FROM mydb.pid_hunter_tote_reservations WHERE expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM occupied WHERE tote_number = 1) THEN 1
  ELSE MIN(o.tote_number + 1)
END AS value
FROM occupied o
LEFT JOIN occupied next_tote ON next_tote.tote_number = o.tote_number + 1
WHERE next_tote.tote_number IS NULL

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(scanned_at, '15m'), COUNT(*) AS value
FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans
WHERE mode = 'COMPACTION' AND compacted = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT scanned_at, compacted_from AS source_location, current_location AS destination_location,
  tote_number AS destination_tote, `partition` AS destination_partition, COUNT(*) AS barcodes_moved
FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans
WHERE mode = 'COMPACTION' AND compacted = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(scanned_at)
GROUP BY scanned_at, compacted_from, current_location, tote_number, `partition`
ORDER BY scanned_at DESC

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY barcode ORDER BY scanned_at DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
  FROM mydb.pid_hunter_scans s
)
SELECT t.tote_number, t.tote_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.`partition` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partition_1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.`partition` = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partition_2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.`partition` = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partition_3,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.`partition` = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partition_4,
  COUNT(l.barcode) AS total_units
FROM mydb.pid_hunter_totes t
INNER JOIN latest l ON l.tote_number = t.tote_number AND l.row_num = 1 AND l.bucket = 'GOOD'
WHERE t.is_free = FALSE
GROUP BY t.tote_number, t.tote_id
ORDER BY t.tote_number
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT barcode) AS value FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(handover, '')) AS value FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tote_number) AS value FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(injested_at, '15m'), handover AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer
WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at) AND handover <> ''
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT injested_at AS stocked_out_at, handover, barcode, pid, tote, tote_simplified, tote_number, `partition`,
  scan_location, nexs_location, status, `condition`, availability, scanned_at AS original_scan_at
FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer
WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at)
ORDER BY injested_at DESC

SELECT DATE(injested_at) AS stock_out_date, handover, COUNT(DISTINCT barcode) AS barcodes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pid) AS pids, COUNT(DISTINCT tote_number) AS totes,
  MIN(injested_at) AS first_stock_out, MAX(injested_at) AS last_stock_out
FROM mydb.scanned_barcode_inventory_transfer
WHERE $__timeFilter(injested_at) AND handover <> ''
GROUP BY DATE(injested_at), handover
ORDER BY stock_out_date DESC, handover
